contentEn:
A whole house renovation in Metro Vancouver means tearing out multiple rooms, replacing finishes throughout, and often touching the structure — all at once. Here is what real Vancouver and Richmond homeowners paid in 2025, and what you should plan for in 2026.

What Is a Whole House Renovation?

Unlike a single-room refresh, a whole house renovation covers multiple systems across the entire home: flooring, kitchen, bathrooms, painting, trim, and often electrical or plumbing updates. In Metro Vancouver's aging housing stock — especially 1970s–1990s ranches and split-levels in Richmond, Surrey, and Coquitlam — a full-home project typically involves rewiring, repiping, or re-insulating as part of the scope.

How Much Does a Whole House Renovation Cost in Vancouver?

Based on actual Reno Stars project data, here is what homeowners paid for whole-house and multi-room renovation projects completed in the Vancouver area:

  • Vancouver whole house with bathroom updates: $23,000 – $25,000, 4–5 weeks
  • Vancouver custom whole house renovation: $25,000 – $27,000, 2–3 weeks
  • Richmond budget-friendly condo renovation: $26,000 – $28,000, 4–5 weeks
  • Richmond condo flooring replacement: project-specific scope
  • Vancouver WFH office conversion (single room): $5,000 – $8,000, 1 week

What Drives the Cost Up or Down?

  • Scope of work: Full-home repiping or rewiring adds $8,000–$20,000 to the project. Cosmetic-only renovations stay at the lower end.
  • Property type: Single-family houses have more surface area than condos but easier site access. Strata-managed condos add approval overhead.
  • Material choices: Engineered hardwood runs $8–$14/sq ft installed; natural stone countertops add $2,000–$6,000 per kitchen. These choices move the total significantly.
  • Age of home: Pre-1980 homes often contain asbestos or knob-and-tube wiring that requires remediation before work begins.
  • City permit requirements: Vancouver, Richmond, and Surrey each have different permit thresholds for structural and electrical work.

How Long Does a Whole House Renovation Take?

For a typical single-family home with moderate scope: 4 to 8 weeks for the main living areas, with kitchen and bathroom work front-loaded so the home remains habitable. Condo projects tend to run faster (3–5 weeks) due to simpler utility runs.

How to Budget for Your Whole House Renovation in 2026

Start with a realistic square-foot estimate: in Greater Vancouver, a full-home cosmetic renovation typically runs $90–$150 per square foot; a comprehensive gut renovation with systems work runs $150–$280 per square foot. For a 1,500 sq ft home, that means $135,000–$420,000 depending on scope.

Add a 10–15% contingency fund before you sign a contract — unexpected structural or mechanical issues are common in Metro Vancouver's older housing stock.

温哥华大温地区的全屋装修涉及多个区域同时施工：地板、厨房、卫生间、油漆、装饰线条，有时还包括结构改造。以下是2025年温哥华和列治文业主的实际花费，以及2026年的预算参考。

全屋装修包含哪些项目？

与单房间翻新不同，全屋装修通常覆盖整个住宅的多个系统：地板、厨房、卫生间、油漆、装饰线条，以及水电更新。在大温地区1970至1990年代的独立屋和错层式住宅中，全屋项目往往涉及重新布线、管道更换或保温升级。

温哥华全屋装修费用是多少？

根据Reno Stars的实际项目数据，以下是大温地区全屋和多房间装修项目的业主实际支出：

  • 温哥华全屋+卫生间更新：23,000–25,000加元，4–5周
  • 温哥华定制全屋装修：25,000–27,000加元，2–3周
  • 列治文经济型公寓装修：26,000–28,000加元，4–5周

影响装修费用的关键因素

  • 工程范围：全屋管道或线路更换需额外支付8,000–20,000加元。纯装修项目费用较低。
  • 房屋类型：独立屋面积更大但进场更容易。公寓需额外通过物业管理审批。
  • 材料选择：工程木地板安装费用8–14加元/平方英尺；天然石材台面每个厨房额外2,000–6,000加元。
  • 房屋年代：1980年前建成的房屋常含有石棉或老式线路，施工前需进行专业处理。

真实客户评价

S Wilson（温哥华） — 五星评价：
"我们之前经历过多次装修，这次和Reno Stars的合作是最顺利的。Ryan非常容易合作，提供了详细的图纸和材料样品，组织了合适的施工人员，保持现场整洁，没有对周边区域造成任何损坏，沟通也非常顺畅……按时按预算完成了项目。"

Brad Darnell（列治文） — 五星评价：
"Reno Stars在材料选择上提供了非常专业的建议，工作质量很高。我的项目包括新硬木地板、瓷砖地板和油漆。我会向任何追求高质量的人推荐他们。"
